author: Dustin Burke
subject: EUC discovery - Lucas Hoffman
body:
Call w/ Lucas Hoffman (Dir End User Computing). Owns the laptop fleet.

- ~1,400 laptops, mostly Aster 3 14 G1 bought 2018-2019, plus Cadence micros + Wisp thin clients in the SOC. Everyone on Win10.
- Analysts + consultants are heavy users - VMs, packet capture, multiple monitors. 16GB is the pain point, want 32GB standard.
- Security: everything BitLocker, they're a cybersecurity firm so they're strict on drive handling - "drives never leave our building unless they're shredded."
- Refresh window: they'd like to do the whole fleet at once in FY24, budget permitting. CFO prefers opex.

Next: get Lucas a refresh TCO with Orvane Financial Services options. Sneha is leaving the territory in Aug - whoever picks up the AE seat needs this.

author: Nathan Owens
subject: Vault DP booked
body: SO-30307458 ($109,032, PO JCS-45455) - Vault DP5900 as Corsalis DataGuard target w/ immutable snapshots. Booked straight off the quote, no opp (my miss). Second try - the Oct '21 version (0065f00004kOL0lAAG) died on budget. Erin Singh (security eng) ran the eval. Ransomware resilience is a big theme for them (they sell it, they need to show they have it).

author: Sean Nguyen
subject: FY24 fleet refresh planning
body:
Attendees: Victoria Ramirez (CIO), Lucas Hoffman (Dir EUC), Rebecca Tanaka (Procurement Mgr); Sean Nguyen, Dustin Burke, Rachel Wells (services)

Goal: plan the full laptop refresh for spring 2023.

Discussion:
- Target spec: Aster 7 G3 class, C7 / 32GB / 1TB, Win 11 ready. ~700 seats in phase 1 (consultants + analysts), rest (exec, SOC desktops) phase 2.
- Victoria wants it off the balance sheet - OFS. Options walked through: FMV (lowest payment, return at end), $1 buyout (higher payment, own at end), Device-as-a-Service bundle (hardware + ProCare + deployment + end-of-term ITAD in one monthly).
- Data handling: any return means drives come back to Orvane. Victoria: non-starter unless drives stay on site - Keep Your Drive + on-site sanitization with certificates per serial. OFS says KYD can ride inside the DaaS bundle.
- Deployment: zero-touch via Autopilot + Orvane Manage, Rachel to scope white-glove for execs.
- Docks: office-based staff get a Tether dock, bundle into the agreement.

Decision: leaning DaaS bundle, 36 months, phase 1 - Victoria likes one monthly number and a forced refresh cycle.

Actions: Sean quote via OFS. Rachel deployment SOW. Lucas pilot 20 units in Jan.

author: Bryce Gibson
subject: Lease structure + final config
body:
Attendees: Lucas Hoffman, Rebecca Tanaka, Karen Doyle (incoming CIO - Victoria leaving in April); Bryce Gibson (new AE, took over Feb 1), Morgan Sato

Re-did a lot of what Sean covered in Nov - his notes had the decision but not the reasons, Karen wanted to hear it again.

Final:
- 709x Aster 7 16 G3, C7 / 32GB / 1TB - Lucas got his 32GB; Karen trimmed seat count to consultants/analysts only instead of cutting spec.
- 709x Tether docks + 219x Clarity monitors for the hot-desk floors.
- OFS Device-as-a-Service Bundle, 36 months, starts on ship date (target 4/28). ProCare Plus + Keep Your Drive inside the bundle.
- Lease schedule will show 1,637 units (laptops, docks and monitors are separate line items) - flagged to Rebecca so finance doesn't think it's 1,637 laptops.
- Imaged with current corporate image (Win10 - Lucas says Win11 image not ready, will upgrade in place later).

Karen asked about end of term: DaaS = return + refresh, extend, or buy out at fair market value. Drives stay with them under KYD either way. She wants that in writing.

Phase 2 (~2,900 seats incl. SOC desktops + remaining staff... Lucas's number, seems high) - separate opp.

Next: Rebecca to issue PO after Karen signs agreement.

author: Quinn Weber
subject: Intro - new AE
body:
Intro w/ Lucas. I took over mid-Aug (Bryce left in July).

Asked about the lease - Lucas said it's 1,637 devices ending April 2026. I had it as 1,637 laptops in my head from the lease record; Lucas corrected: 709 laptops + 709 docks + 219 monitors. Also I thought it was a $1 buyout (they own at end) - it's not, it's a DaaS bundle, so return/refresh, extend or FMV buyout at the end. Updating my notes.

- Win11 still not rolled out. ~26% of fleet. In-place upgrade planned "next year".
- Phase 2 still frozen. The ~$1.0M opp is still sitting open under Bryce's name - Lucas says nothing is happening this year.

Next: close or push those opps. Quarterly check-in.

author: Quinn Weber
subject: Closed stale phase 2 opp
body: Phase 2 0065f00004kPgqZAAS ($1,013,596) closed lost 10/23 - still owned by Bryce, no activity since May. Nathan's server opp (0065f00004kQEkJAAW) went the same way back in May. Cost freeze through FY25 per Lucas. Real next event is LSE-301683 end of term 4/28/2026.

author: Samuel Perry
subject: Account plan - lease end is the play
body:
Account plan (new AE as of March - 3rd owner in 14 months, Lucas noticed).

Key date: LSE-301683 (OFS DaaS bundle) ends 4/28/2026. 709 Aster 7 16 G3 + 709 Tether docks + 219 Clarity monitors = 1,637 units.
Options to prep for customer:
1. Return + refresh on a new DaaS bundle - old units out via Orvane ITAD, drives stay on site (KYD).
2. Extend 12 months at a reduced rate.
3. Buy out at FMV and keep. G3s are Win11-capable C7 / 32GB - solid spec, but battery wear will show by yr 3-4.

Other timing: Win10 end of support Oct 2025. Fleet ~48% Win11. Older Aster 3 14 G1 units (~200 left) are NOT Win11 eligible - those need to go regardless.

Stakeholders: Karen Doyle (CIO, decides), Lucas Hoffman (EUC, champion), Rebecca Tanaka (procurement), Lindsey Richardson (VP Digital Transformation - owns budget for "workplace"), security engineers Krista Romero / Carly Martinez on sanitization standards. (Two Lucas Hoffman contact records - one with an all-caps email - need merging.)

Competition: Helixon has been in front of Lindsey with a DaaS offer.

Start lease-end conversation no later than Q1 FY26.

author: Chad Walker
subject: Servers & HCI FY25 Q4 closed lost

They extended support on the old vSphere 8 hosts instead of refreshing. James Turner is the tech lead on DC/backup. The Atlas 120 x11 from Feb (0065f00004kQBasAAG) is the footprint to grow, and the Vault from April (0065f00004kQNxdAAG) is filling fast.

author: Samuel Perry
subject: Lease-end options workshop
body:
Attendees: Lucas Hoffman, Rebecca Tanaka, Krista Romero (Security Eng); Samuel Perry, Kelsey Cox, Michael Wood

Agenda: LSE-301683 end-of-term (4/28/2026) - refresh vs extend vs buyout; Win11; ITAD.

State of fleet (Lucas):
- 709 G3s in service minus ~25 lost/stolen/RMA'd (insurance + DaaS casualty claims, Rebecca to reconcile). Battery health reports: ~30% under 80% capacity.
- Win11 at ~90%. In-place upgrade of G3s nearly done.
- ~200 Aster 3 14 G1s still around - not Win11 eligible. Must retire before Oct.

Options discussed:
1. FMV buyout + keep: Lucas worried about yr 4-5 failure rates on consultant machines.
2. Refresh: return G3s, new Aster on a new DaaS bundle, timed to April 2026. OFS handles return logistics; drives stay here under KYD.
3. Extension: OFS can extend 12 months at a reduced payment.

Sanitization requirements (Krista):
- NIST 800-88 Purge minimum, crypto-erase on the SED drives, verification + certificate per serial.
- SOC + incident response laptops (~150): physical shred on-site, drives never leave.
- Chain of custody docs for audit; customer witness on site.

Michael: Orvane ITAD can do on-site purge + shred, certificate per serial. For returned DaaS units the chassis go back to OFS, drives stay.

Notice: Rebecca thinks OFS needs written notice of intent 90 days before end. Need to confirm.

Actions: Kelsey refresh quote (Aster 5 14 + Tether). Michael ITAD quote (G3s + ~200 G1s). Samuel get OFS end-of-term letter + notice requirements.

body:

- If we refresh, can the new agreement start before the old one ends so we're not paying both for 3 months?

Also - our records show 1,637 laptops on this agreement but Lucas says it's 709. Can you send the schedule by line item? Finance needs it for the asset register.

Rebecca Tanaka
Procurement Manager, Juniper Crossing Systems

author: Samuel Perry
subject: Lease-end decision - exec review
body:
Attendees: Karen Doyle (CIO), Lindsey Richardson (VP Digital Transformation), Lucas Hoffman, Rebecca Tanaka; Samuel Perry, Kelsey Cox, Natalie Wang

FY26 IT budget is ~$12.3M and the data center refresh already took a bite (Atlas 120 x4, 0065f00004kRc0zAAC).

Karen's direction:
- Not refreshing all 709 at once.
- Leaning hybrid: return ~300 consultant/analyst G3s and refresh those on a new DaaS bundle; FMV buyout on the healthiest ~400 to keep 12-18 more months.
- The ~200 G1s + any G3 that fails battery/health check go to ITAD in Q1 regardless.
- Win11: finish in-place upgrade on kept G3s by March (at ~96% now). Natalie: Orvane Manage can push feature update + report compliance.

Lindsey wants Orvane Flex pricing on the 300 to compare to DaaS. Helixon also quoted her a DaaS bundle with ITAD included.

Concerns: Krista's sanitization requirements apply to all retirements - Michael's ITAD quote needs per-serial certificates + on-site shred for SOC units.

Next steps: Kelsey revised quote for ~300 Aster 5 14 (DaaS + Flex), first tranche on 0065f00004kS3TGAA0. Natalie Manage/Win11 compliance proposal. Samuel confirm with OFS that partial return + partial FMV buyout is allowed on one schedule. Notice deadline 1/28.

Returned DaaS chassis go back to OFS, drives stay under KYD. Krista wants their own witness on every shred day. @Samuel Perry they want this scheduled before 4/28 if possible.

Hi Rebecca,

Quick reminder that the notice of intent for LSE-301683 is due to Orvane Financial Services this Wednesday, 1/28.

Based on Karen's direction in November, the notice would state:
